title: A hand writes on the wall
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child explains Daniel 5: King Belshazzar drinks from the holy vessels of the temple and praises idols, a hand writes on the wall, Daniel refuses the rewards but reads it (numbered, weighed, divided), and the kingdom falls that night.

floor.prerequisite: Knows Joseph interpreted a king's dreams.
floor.question: Who gave Joseph the meaning of Pharaoh's dreams?

representations: a wall with four strange words
gold cups drawn on a table
steps: He uses the temple vessels and praises idols.
A hand writes on the wall.
contexts: a child using a church Bible as a footstool
pride before a fall in a football team

board.do: Draw a wall with a hand writing on it.

board.say: What did it say about the king's kingdom?

board.do: Wait for the child to say numbered, weighed, divided.

misconceptions.ask: Which king held the feast in Daniel 5?
misconceptions.repair: Read Daniel 5:1 and write the name.

misconceptions.ask: Whose hand wrote on the wall?

listen_for: They were too heavy to carry
misconceptions.ask: Why was it wrong to use the gold and silver vessels at the feast?
What did the writing say about the king's kingdom?
misconceptions.repair: Read Daniel 5:25-28 and match mene, tekel and peres.

checks.question: Which king held the feast in Daniel 5?
Why was it wrong to use the vessels?
checks.answer: They were holy, from God's temple

skills.key_step: The child says humility is not boasting and giving God the glory, contrasts proud Belshazzar with humble Daniel (who refused the rewards), and lists benefits of humility (God honours it, people trust you, you learn).

floor.prerequisite: Knows the story of the writing on the wall.
floor.question: Who read the writing on the wall?

steps: What did Daniel say about the gifts?
contexts: a top learner who helps others
a class prefect who admits a mistake
a winner who thanks the team

board.do: Draw two columns: proud and humble.

board.say: What did Daniel do that shows humility?

board.do: Wait for the child to say he refused the gifts and gave God credit.

listen_for: Being weak and having no opinions
misconceptions.repair: Ask whether Daniel was weak when he spoke to the king.

misconceptions.ask: Who showed pride in the story?
misconceptions.repair: Read Daniel 5:22-23, where Daniel says Belshazzar did not humble himself.

misconceptions.ask: What did Daniel say to the king's gifts and rewards?
Daniel told the king hard words (Daniel 5:22-23). Was that humble?
misconceptions.repair: Read Daniel 5:17 and 5:22: Daniel refused rewards (humble) and spoke the truth (brave).

checks.question: Name one benefit of humility.
checks.answer: God honours the humble (people trust you)
